newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi cuts June crude prices by $1.35-$1.70.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi cuts June crude prices by $1.35-$1.70.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) has cut its June official crude selling prices by $1.35-$1.70 a barrel, a company statement said on Tuesday.

Murban was cut to $18.35 a barrel from $20. Lower Zakum was dropped by $1.70 to $18.35 a barrel from $20.05 and Umm Shaif was $1.65 lower at $18.10 a barrel. Upper Zakum was cut to $17.35 a barrel from $18.70.
ADNOC sets its official crude prices each month on a retroactive basis on spot market developments.
